name: pad_actuation_above_command
hypothesis: The robot stops pressing near 3 N, while the pads require 4 N to actuate. The separate success check accepts any peak above 1 N, so both presses can pass without registering commands.
expected_failure: Step 9 reports success despite insufficient actuation force; QUICK is not running, producing a silent mission failure.
real_world_story: A replacement control-panel overlay requires a firmer press than the panel used during validation.
